note: Solano County park on the Sacramento River just south of Rio Vista, with a 24-hour boat launch, picnic lawns and a sand beach where swimming isn't allowed (strong currents, sudden drop-offs). The campground is a single treed loop set back behind the launch parking lot and day-use area. Dogs are allowed in the campground but not on the beach or in the picnic area. --Claude
summary: County page (new URL) and the Camava reservation site read, with live site cards and fee quotes.
